blocks.text: Chirevo ichi chinoshanda zvakafanana kune wechitatu-bato midhiya zvinhu zvinoshandiswa kuratidza, kudyidzana kana kushongedzwa pawebhusaiti yeOmniCivitas uye GitHub kodhi repository, kusanganisira mapikicha, emoticons, maGIF, mifananidzo, mavhidhiyo, mimhanzi, ruzha, manzwi uye zvinoenderana nesecondary processing content.

Iwo kodzero, kodzero dzevatambi, kodzero dzevagadziri, maodhiyo nemavhidhiyo evagadziri anobatanidzwa mune zviri pamusoro, pamwe nemufananidzo, zita, izwi uye dzimwe kodzero dzine hukama uye zvido zvinofarirwa nemutemo, ndezvavane kodzero dzemutemo zvakateerana. Iyi purojekiti haitore kodzero kuzvinhu zvepakutanga nekuda kwekuunganidza, kuratidza, kudzvanya, kurima, kushandurwa kwemazwi kana kumwe kugadzirisa; kodzero dzichangowedzerwa dzakasimbiswa maererano nemutemo mune zvechipiri kugadzirisa zvinyorwa hazvitsivi kodzero dzezvinyorwa zvepakutanga.

Zvimwe zvinhu zvinouya kubva kurefu-refu network kuparadzirwa, uye muparidzi wavo wepakutanga, munyori, processor kana akazara muridzi cheni anogona kunge asina kusimbiswa nekuvimbika. Iyi purojekiti haitore zvinhu zvisingazivikanwe kwazvakabva sepakutanga, zvine rezinesi, kana munzvimbo yeruzhinji. Iyo nyaya yekuti zvinyorwa zvinofambiswa zvakanyanya, zvine chigadziriso chakaderera, uye chakadhindwa kakawanda hazvireve kuti kodzero dzakakodzera dzapera.

Iyi purojekiti ndeye isiri-purofiti yemunhu tekinoroji kuyedza uye varaidzo kuratidza. Kuonekwa kwezvinhu hazvireve kuti vane kodzero, makambani, mabasa, mabhureki kana vanhu vari muzvinyorwa vanotora chikamu, kutsigira, kutsigira kana kutsigira chirongwa ichi, uye hazvireve kuti chirongwa ichi chine hukama hwemubatanidzwa navo. Chinangwa chekushandisa kusetsa, chechipiri kugadzirisa kana kusaita purofiti hazvireve kuti mvumo yawanikwa kana kuti zvinonyatsoenderana nekusarudzika kwekushandiswa mumitemo inoshanda.

Mamiriro ekushandisa eiyo kodhi kodhi ari pasi peLICENSE mudura uye tsananguro yerezinesi yefaira rinoenderana. Kunyangwe iyo kodhi yepurojekiti ikatora rezinesi reMIT, rezinesi haringovharike mifananidzo yevatatu, maGIF, odhiyo nevhidhiyo, zviratidzo kana zvimwe zvemidhiya. Wechitatu-bato kodhi iri pasi pemarezinesi avo.

Iyi purojekiti haipe vashandisi mvumo yekukopa, kugadzirisa, kuparadzira kana kushambadzira zvinhu zvechitatu-bato kuburikidza nechirevo ichi. Kana paine rezinesi kana mvumo yezvakasiyana, rezinesi kana mvumo ndiyo ichatonga; chirevo ichi hachitsive, kuwedzera kana kukanzura. Kuvhara repository, kudhawunirodha mafaera kana kuendesa webhusaiti hazvireve kuti wawana kodzero yekushandisa midhiya zvinhu.

Kana muridzi wekodzero kana mumiriri wake ane mvumo achitenda kuti zvinhu zviri muchirongwa ichi zvinosanganisira kodzero dzake nezvaanofarira, anogona kupa mhinduro kuburikidza neChinyorwa chiri muGitHub repository yepurojekiti iyi kana kuburikidza nematanho ekusangana anoburitswa neanochengeta. Kuti ufambise kutsvaga nekuona, ndapota tsanangura mapeji akakodzera, mafaera kana zvinhu, kodzero dzinonzi, huridzi hunogoneka kana hwaro hwesangano, uye nzira yaunoda kugadzirisa.

Ndokumbirawo usaendese ruzivo rwakadzama rwemunhu senge magwaro ekuzivikanwa, kero, nhamba dzenhare, nezvimwe mune zveruzhinji nyaya; paunoda kuendesa chitupa chisiri cheruzhinji, ndapota tanga wakumbira muchengeti kuti akupe yakavanzika yekuonana chiteshi. Iyi purojekiti haizoramba kuratidza zvinonzwisisika zvichemo zvichibva pa "online circulation" kana ichi chirevo, uye ichatora kumiswa kwekuratidzira, kutsiva, kudzima kana mamwe matanho anodiwa zvichienderana nemamiriro ekuongorora uye mitemo inoshanda.

Ichi chirevo chinoshandiswa kutsanangura miganhu yekodzero uye nzira dzemhinduro dzezvinyorwa. Harisi gwaro remvumo kubva kumuridzi wekodzero, uye hakusi kuzvipira kusunungurwa kubva pamhosva yepamutemo. Vachengeti vanotakura mabasa anoenderana ekushandisa kwavo, kuratidza uye kugovera zvinoenderana nemutemo; iyo chaiyo kodzero uye zvisungo zvemapato akakodzera zviri pasi pemitemo inoshanda, marezinesi anoshanda uye mamiriro chaiwo. Chirevo ichi hachinyime kana kurambidza vane kodzero kuti vatore kodzero dzavo maererano nemutemo, uye kudzima, kutsiviwa kana kubviswa mumasherufu kunozobva kwabvisa zvikwereti zvepamutemo zvinenge zvamuka.
